messages:
maria: Heads-up — brought up new tiny-ranklight-v2 reranker on the QA-2k holdout. FP16 baseline NDCG@10=0.412, MRR=0.342. PTQ INT8 build shows NDCG@10=0.399 (−0.013) and MRR=0.335 (−0.007).
kevin: that drop is small but could be meaningful, any differences in query/doc formatting between eval runs?
maria: good call — I noticed our preprocessing added a 6-token prefix for provenance on the candidate docs in the quant eval run (not in baseline). suspect tokenization shift + KV cache alignment.
anil: PTQ variance can also come from calibration set selection. what cal set did you use?
maria: used sample of 5k training docs w/ uniform doc-length sampling. calibration config: 1024 batches, per-layer min-max, clipping disabled.
sara: can you repro with identical preprocessing and just swap the FP16 vs INT8 model binary? that'll isolate quant noise vs data formatting.
maria: yep planning that. quick diag command I'm running now:
```
./eval_harness --model tiny-ranklight-v2-int8
  --queries holdout-qa-2k.json --candidates candidates-v1.json
  --preproc-config preproc/prov-prefix-off.yaml
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --seed 42 --sample-size 500
```
kevin: also run with --seed 7 and --seed 123 to estimate sampling variance. and include a run with the prefix enabled but removed from tokenization (strip before tokenizing) to see if prefix tokenization is the culprit.
anil: +1. for PTQ, run quantize with re-run calibration using both uniform and stratified length buckets. differences show up a lot for long docs.
maria: noted. initial quick check (500 samples) results posted to the console: INT8 (prefix-off) NDCG@10=0.410, MRR=0.340; INT8 (prefix-on) NDCG@10=0.398, MRR=0.334. so prefix-on degrades — looks like doc formatting.
sara: that's a pretty clear signal. could be early-term truncation too if prefix pushes important tokens out of the 512 window.
kevin: can you paste a minimal failing example (query + candidate) so we can tokenizer-debug?
maria: adding one:
"query": "how to rotate vector in 2d",
"candidate_fp": "Origin:docs | ... | steps: use matrix [cos -sin; sin cos] ...",
"tokenized_with_prefix": "[CLS] Origin : docs | ... steps : use matrix ...",
"tokenized_without_prefix": "[CLS] steps : use matrix ..."
kevin: looks like prefix insertion moves the answer tokens outside seqlen 256 for some docs. try increasing seqlen or moving prefix to suffix for candidates and retest.
anil: long term: we should standardize candidate provenance handling in preproc (prefix vs metadata field) so tokenization is invariant. file an infra ticket?
sara: I can own a small PR: change default preproc to attach provenance as metadata (not inline) and add an ablation flag.
maria: thanks. immediate next steps I'm running: (1) replicate FP16 vs INT8 with identical preproc (prefix-off) across 3 seeds, (2) stratified calibration buckets, (3) ablation with prefix-as-meta. will post consolidated numbers + minimal failing examples here.
eval-bot: automated run complete — summary uploaded to console: https://console.redwood.internal/runs/2256789012-quickdiag (contains per-query diffs, tokenization debug CSV).
kevin: great. once we have replicated, let's decide: revert quant rollout or ship with preproc fix + quick canary. :thumbsup:
maria: agreed. will update by EOD with replication results. :calendar:
